descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Backyard basketball without the part where you chase the ball down the driveway.

Grab a ball off the rack, feel the swing, release at the top. Every ball returns
on its own, so there is nothing to retrieve and nothing to break your rhythm.
Just arc, release, and the sound of a clean net.

LIMITLESS
Teleport to any spot on the floor and shoot as long as you like. Corner threes,
elbows, the free throw line. Every attempt feeds your lifetime percentages.

ARCADE
Beat the target before the clock runs out. Consecutive makes bank bonus time, so
a hot streak carries you further than a steady one.

3PT CONTEST
The classic format. Five racks, five balls each, 25 shots. Regular makes are
worth one and moneyballs two, and you choose which rack is loaded entirely with
moneyballs before you start.

CHALLENGE
15 handbuilt trick shot levels. Arc over blockers, thread floating rings, bank
off angled boards, and time the sweeping panels. Three makes clears a level, and
doing it in your first three balls earns all three stars.

MAKE IT YOURS
Swap ball skins, recolor the court, lines and spot beams, and set the music to
taste.

YOUR NUMBERS, KEPT
Field goal percentage, threes, twos, best Arcade level, best contest score and
every Challenge star carry over between sessions.
